title: Decide whether a fused kernel is eligible
description: Choose the target hardware and tensor contract. The lab checks the direct FlashAttention-2 package surface, then makes fallback or rejection explicit.

hardware.label: CPU runtime
hardware.detail: No accelerator-specific FlashAttention-2 package kernel in this matrix.

hardware.label: NVIDIA T4
hardware.detail: Turing CUDA device; the official package directs Turing users to a separate repository.

hardware.label: NVIDIA RTX 4090
hardware.detail: Ada consumer GPU in the official CUDA FlashAttention-2 support family.

hardware.label: NVIDIA A100
hardware.detail: Ampere data-center GPU in the official CUDA FlashAttention-2 support family.

hardware.label: NVIDIA H100
hardware.detail: Hopper GPU supported by FlashAttention-2; newer Hopper-specific kernels require separate version checks.

hardware.label: AMD MI300X
hardware.detail: CDNA accelerator in the official ROCm composable-kernel support family.

kernels.label: FlashAttention-2 CUDA
kernels.detail: Official package path for Ampere, Ada, and Hopper.

kernels.label: FlashAttention-2 ROCm CK
kernels.detail: Official composable-kernel backend for supported AMD accelerators.

dtypes.label: FP16
dtypes.detail: Direct FlashAttention-2 package dtype on supported accelerators.

dtypes.label: BF16
dtypes.detail: Direct package dtype on supported modern accelerators; check device capability.

dtypes.label: FP32
dtypes.detail: Use a general SDPA or math path for the official CUDA and ROCm CK package surfaces.

masks.label: Causal flag
masks.detail: Triangular masking represented by the kernel's causal option.

masks.label: Arbitrary dense bias
masks.detail: A per-element mask or bias that is not represented by the basic direct package call.

executions.label: Training, no dropout
executions.detail: Forward and backward with dropout disabled.

executions.label: Training, dropout 0.1
executions.detail: Forward and backward with attention dropout enabled.

fallback.label: PyTorch SDPA auto-dispatch
fallback.detail: Let scaled_dot_product_attention select another enabled fused implementation or the math backend, and capture warnings or profiler evidence for the actual path.

note: The direct-kernel matrix summarizes the official flash-attn repository support surface. PyTorch SDPA backend eligibility changes with framework version, build flags, device, dtype, mask, dropout, layout, and shape; this lab intentionally does not guess the backend selected by another installed build.
